title: A public quickstart demo answers with x-robots-tag noindex, nofollow while staying published; a published customer site keeps no noindex
steps: S1: Through barRoutes, GET / on a published demo (site.demo = true, badge on) and read x-robots-tag and the body.
S2: The same on a published demo installed without a badge.
S3: GET /robots.txt on a published demo and compare the body with the site's own robots.txt.
S4: GET / on a published customer site and read x-robots-tag.
S5: Call proxySite directly with publish published/draft and demo true/false and read x-robots-tag.
expect: S1: x-robots-tag is "noindex, nofollow" and the Tracy badge script is in the page.
S2: x-robots-tag is "noindex, nofollow" and the page is untouched.
S3: the site's own robots.txt, not the draft Disallow-all text.
S5: null for a published customer site, "noindex, nofollow" for a draft and for every demo.
evidence: Google Search Console for tracy.ai: demos took most impressions on unrelated queries; 2026-11-17 the demos answered with no x-robots-tag
fence: The noindex decision in proxySite (publish !== 'published' || demo === true) and the demo flag passed by bar/route.js

tests: a demo advertises with the Tracy badge
a demo installed without a badge is proxied untouched
a demo robots.txt is its own, proxied
a published customer site keeps the managed pill
proxySite: noindex follows publish for a customer site and is always on for a demo
